svg.title: Single Static Billboard Cash-Flow Funnel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-static-billboard-cash-flow-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: Single Static Billboard Cash-Flow Funnel; subtitle: From full-calendar rate card to about $7,000 a year of true cash flow; caption: A two-sided static board at $600 per face per month and 80% occupancy keeps roughly 60% of occupied revenue after costs, then trades at 8 to 10 times cash flow, or $55,000 to $70,000.; assumptions note: Inputs are Acquisition Insider's: $600 per face per month, two faces, 80% occupancy, roughly 40% costs including a 15% to 20% ground lease. Intermediate dollar values are straight arithmetic on those inputs; the ground-lease stages show the low and high end of the stated band.; note: Source: Acquisition Insider (4PyMov-VjoE @ 00:02:07).; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Full-Calendar Rate Card; value: 14400; display: $14,400/yr; conversion: 100%; detail: $600 per face per month, two faces, twelve months sold.; label: Revenue at 80% Occupancy; value: 11520; display: $11,520/yr; conversion: 80% of rate card; detail: Occupancy assumption used in the single-board model.; label: After a 15% Ground Lease; value: 9792; display: $9,792/yr; conversion: 85% of occupied revenue; detail: Low end of the 15% to 20% ground-lease band.; label: After a 20% Ground Lease; value: 9216; display: $9,216/yr; conversion: 80% of occupied revenue; detail: High end of the 15% to 20% ground-lease band.; label: True Cash Flow After ~40% Costs; value: 6912; display: About $7,000/yr; conversion: 60% of occupied revenue; detail: Trades at 8 to 10 times cash flow, or $55,000 to $70,000.

circle.title: label: Full-Calendar Rate Card; value: 14400; display: $14,400/yr; conversion: 100%; detail: $600 per face per month, two faces, twelve months sold.

label: After a 20% Ground Lease; value: 9216; display: $9,216/yr; conversion: 80% of occupied revenue; detail: High end of the 15% to 20% ground-lease band.
label: True Cash Flow After ~40% Costs; value: 6912; display: About $7,000/yr; conversion: 60% of occupied revenue; detail: Trades at 8 to 10 times cash flow, or $55,000 to $70,000.
